impact: Hot core inflation locks in a December hike and lifts January odds, pressuring yields-sensitive growth names MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS, PLTR and HOOD; C is the relative winner from higher rates.
summary: October core PCE rose 3.3% year over year versus 3.2% expected and 3.1% in September; headline PCE was 3.8%, in line, and both rose 0.3% on the month. Q3 GDP was revised up to a 4.3% annualized pace from 3.4%, above the 3.5% consensus, while real consumer spending was flat in October. Traders already priced about a 96% chance of a December 9 Fed hike; the Nasdaq-100 fund was down 2.9% before the bell.
title: Core PCE runs hot at 3.3%; Q3 GDP revised up to 4.3%
